From Window Washing Robots to Eye Popping Home Entertainment Experiences, Consumer Technology Guru Andrea Smith Gives Her Top Tech Picks for the Holiday Season

NEW YORK , NY, UNITED STATES, November 16, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- It’s the time of year holiday shoppers wait for, Black Friday & Cyber Monday! That’s when the official holiday shopping season begins and consumers can get a jump on the best deals before they sell out. Tech expert and award-winning journalist, Andrea Smith has a sneak peek at the best deals in tech from creative crafting to window washing robots, cutting edge home entertainment and even home security.

For the tech lover and crafter Andrea says “Cricut is a favorite among hobbyists. And its newest machine, the StickerPix Print, turns your photos into stickers and cards right at home.” Smith says it’s also great for holiday cards, party invitations, or just a way to bring your holiday memories to life. “If you need a little inspiration, the Design Space app has thousands of fonts and templates. On Black Friday you can get it for $119.00, that’s $50.00 off.

There are some smart tech upgrades available, like a robotic window cleaner. “I don’t know about yours, but no one in my family likes washing windows,” says Smith, “The ECOVACS WINBOT W3 Omni is a robotic window cleaner that attaches to the glass with suction and cleans both inside and out, so there’s no climbing on a ladder.” Safety features keep it securely in place, even on floor-to-ceiling windows. The ECOVACS WINBOT W3 Omni is on sale Black Friday for $549.00, $150.00 off its regular price.

If you’re looking for a home entertainment upgrade, Smith has her eye on the big screen. “Roku just launched its first OLED TV. With deeper blacks, richer colors, and Dolby Vision, this will be great for re-watching those holiday classics.” Come November 27th, the 65-inch Roku Pro Series OLEDTV will be on sale for $799.00, 30% off its regular price. Smith also likes the Roku Streaming Stick, “It lets you bring your favorite streaming apps along when you travel and is half off at $19.99.”

Finally, to give the gift of peace of mind, Smith has found a great deal. “For Black Friday shoppers, SimpliSafe is offering up to 70% off systems with professional monitoring.” Andrea says the new Video Doorbell Series 2 doesn’t just record, but with Active Guard monitoring, “It can detect potential threats like a package thief or an intruder and alert live U.S. agents. They can talk through the doorbell, sound a siren and request police.” Smith likes the affordability, ease of set up, and the fact that it doesn’t require a contract.

 The countdown to Black Friday is on, and the discounts are starting to appear. Although the shopping holiday isn’t officially until November 27th, retailers are already dropping early deals on some of our favorite tech. Of course, with prices rising across the board, a good discount doesn’t necessarily mean you’re getting a historically low price. But we’re still seeing worthwhile discounts on a host of tried-and-tested gear, with more expected in the coming weeks.

 Below, we’ve rounded up the best early Black Friday deals we’ve found so far. Prices could drop further as Black Friday approaches, as is always the case, but these deals are worth considering if you’d rather shop early and beat the holiday rush. We’ll continue to update this guide as more retailers launch their holiday sales, too, so be sure to check back regularly as we get closer to the main event.

 Electronics deals published so far
 Black Friday electronic deals for 2026 run on store calendars that started in late October, so the question is less "what is on sale on 27 November" and more "which week does each store drop its tech deals". This page collects what the big electronics sellers have published, explains when each kind of device tends to be cheapest, and points to our guides for TVs, laptops, phones and the rest.

 Amazon Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deal events kick off at 12:01 a.m. PST on 19 November and run through 30 November; Black Friday 27 November, Cyber Monday 30 November Early deals in its Holiday Shop; its 9 November deals preview lists up to $600 off select Sony and Hisense TVs, up to 50% off select Beats, JBL, Marshall and Sonos headphones and speakers, and up to 30% off select ASUS, Acer, Alienware, Lenovo and HP laptops and gaming PCs 10 Nov 
 Costco and Amazon are named without links because we do not have a US store page we can link for them. Every Black Friday offer we track is on our Black Friday deals page .
 Store by store: what each retailer has said about tech
 Best Buy
 Best Buy's holiday calendar of 27 October is the clearest electronics schedule this year: Early Black Friday Deals and Doorbusters from 6 November with new deals each Friday, then 10 days of Black Friday deals from 19 November. My Best Buy Plus and Total members earn double rewards from 19 November to 6 December. Our Best Buy Black Friday guide covers its Doorbusters, price match and returns.
 10 Days Black DEAL 
 DEAL 
 Best Buy Black Friday Doorbusters and Deals, 10 Days From 19 November
 Best Buy runs 10 days of Black Friday doorbusters and deals starting on 19 November 2026; Black Friday itself is 27 November. Stores are closed on Thanksgiving Day, 26 November, while the deals continue in the Best Buy app and on BestBuy.com, per its holiday calendar of 27 October 2026. 
 Get Deal Expires: Nov 28, 2026
 Walmart
 Walmart's events open on Walmart.com at 12:01 a.m. ET and in stores at 6 a.m. local time. Walmart+ members get early access to hot Deal drops, and any items left open to everyone at 12:01 a.m. ET the next day. See our Walmart Black Friday guide .
 23 Nov Black DEAL 
 DEAL 
 Walmart Black Friday Deals, 23 to 29 November
 Walmart's Black Friday Deals event runs from 23 to 29 November 2026. It starts on Walmart.com at 12:01 a.m. ET on 23 November and in stores on Black Friday, 27 November, at 6 a.m. local time. Walmart stores are closed on Thanksgiving Day, as stated in Walmart's releases of 7 and 26 October 2026. 
 Get Deal Expires: Nov 29, 2026
 Target
 Target's Black Friday page said its Early Black Friday sale was "back for 3 days, from 11/5 to 11/7", and that sale has ended. Its Deal of the Day runs daily to Christmas Eve, and its holiday release says new limited-time offers follow every weekend through the season. More in our Target Black Friday guide .
 Costco
 Costco publishes each item with a price and a valid-from date, which makes it easy to plan, but you need a membership to buy. Its Black Friday list runs from 27 to 30 November, and the warehouses are closed on Thanksgiving. See our Costco Black Friday guide .
 Amazon and Kohl's
 Amazon says its Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deal events kick off at 12:01 a.m. PST on 19 November and run through 30 November. Its first look at the deals, published on 9 November, names electronics savings without single-model prices: up to $600 on select TVs from Sony and Hisense, up to 50% on select headphones and speakers from Beats, JBL, Marshall and Sonos, and up to 30% on select laptops and gaming PCs from ASUS, Acer, Alienware, Lenovo and HP. Its early deals sit in the Holiday Shop, and our Amazon Black Friday guide follows it. Kohl's included tech in its Early Access event, which ran from 6 to 8 November, and includes it in its Cyber Deals on 29 and 30 November; see our Kohl's Black Friday guide .
 Black Friday or Cyber Monday for electronics?
 Adobe's 2026 holiday forecast, published on 28 September, gives the clearest answer we have found from a named source. Adobe expects the deepest discounts for electronics and computers on Cyber Monday, and the best deals on TVs on Black Friday. Its forecast discount levels, measured against listed prices, are:
 Category Expected peak discount, 2026 2025 
 Electronics 30% 30.1% 
 TVs 23% 24.2% 
 Computers 23% 22.8% 
 Appliances 18% 19.2% 
 Adobe also expects Cyber Monday, 30 November, to be the biggest online shopping day of the season at $15.1 billion, with Black Friday second at $12.9 billion. These are forecasts of averages across many products, not promises about any one item. In practice: if a TV is on your list, Black Friday week is the time to compare closely; for a laptop or headphones, it can pay to check again on Cyber Monday before you buy.
 Our electronics guides by category
 Each category has its own guide with the store dates, prices where stores have published them, and the checks that matter for that product:

 Store pages we track for tech sellers include Newegg , Adorama , GameStop and Govee .
 Smart home, security and small gadgets
 Smart home and security cameras
 None of our category guides covers smart home gear, and Costco is the store that has published the most dated prices for it. These lines were on Costco's holiday savings page on 1 November, valid 16 to 30 November:
 Item, as Costco names it Price Saving Where 
 Ring Outdoor Cam Plus 2 pk + Quick Release Battery Bundle $99.99 $80 off Warehouse and online, limit 5

 Ring Doorbell Plus + Chime + Faceplate $99.99 $80 off Online only, limit 2 
 ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium Plus Pack (2 SmartSensors) $189.99 $40 off Online only 
 Arlo Pro 2K Security Cameras, 4 pk $199.99 $80 off Online only 
 Before you buy a camera or video doorbell, check what the brand charges for a subscription to store recordings, since the bundle price usually covers the hardware only. Also check that a smart thermostat works with your heating system; ecobee and other makers publish compatibility checkers on their own sites.
 Digital frames and small gadgets
 Costco lists the Aura Parker Digital Picture Frame at $99.99 after $30 off, valid 16 to 30 November, limit 5. For speakers, earbuds and other small audio, see our headphones guide .
 How to check an electronics deal
 Match the model number and year. Black Friday listings often use model codes made for the sale, or last year's model. Compare the exact code at two stores, and check the release year on the maker's site.
 Use the store's own price history and alerts. Amazon's FAQ points shoppers to price tracking and deal alerts, and most big stores let you save an item and get an alert. A price that was lower two weeks ago is not a Black Friday saving.
 Read the limits. Costco sets a limit per member on most items, and Walmart reserves some deals for Walmart+ members at first.
 Open-box and refurbished labels. These can be good value, but the warranty and return window may be shorter than for new items. Read both on the listing.
 Count the add-ons. A cheap printer with costly ink, or a camera that needs a subscription, can cost more over a year than a pricier model.
 Our guide Are Black Friday deals real? goes through the price checks step by step.

 Our Black Friday returns and price matching guide has the full rules for each store, including the shorter windows for opened phones and some devices.
 Cyber Monday electronics deals
 Cyber Monday 2026 is Monday 30 November. These are the electronics events the stores have dated:
 Best Buy: a Cyber Sunday and Monday sale, then Cyber Week deals from 1 to 6 December. Best Buy's Black Friday page calls its Cyber Monday deals "an entirely new sale".
 Walmart: Cyber Monday deals from 30 November to 2 December, from 12:01 a.m. ET on Walmart.com.
 Kohl's: Cyber Deals on 29 and 30 November, with 40% off qualifying purchases with a coupon.
 Costco: its Black Friday list runs to 30 November.
 Given Adobe's forecast that electronics and computers see their deepest discounts on Cyber Monday, it is worth keeping a list of models and prices from Black Friday to compare that day. More in our guide to Cyber Monday , our Cyber Week guide and on our Cyber Monday deals page .

 Walmart Cyber Monday Deals Online, 30 November to 2 December
 Walmart's Cyber Monday event runs from 30 November to 2 December 2026 and starts on Walmart.com at 12:01 a.m. ET on 30 November, according to Walmart's holiday release of 26 October 2026. Walmart had not published Cyber Monday prices on 31 October 2026. 
 Get Deal Expires: Dec 02, 2026
 How we check these deals
 The dates and prices here come from the stores' own announcements and pages, read on 1 November 2026: Best Buy's holiday calendar and Black Friday page, Walmart's release of 26 October, Target's Black Friday page, Costco's holiday savings and Black Friday pages, Kohl's release of 30 October, Amazon's Black Friday FAQ, and Adobe's forecast of 28 September. BJ's and Newegg's Black Friday pages blocked our tools, so we have left their offers out. We do not test products, so this guide has no ratings.
 We read these pages on 1 November 2026; on 10 November we read the Target, Kohl's and Walmart dates again, and Amazon's updated Black Friday FAQ and its deals preview of 9 November; check each offer on the store's page before you buy. We plan to refresh this page on 19, 23 and 29 November. For every store's start date, see when Black Friday 2026 starts , and our other guides are in the Black Friday hub . For gift ideas beyond electronics, see our Black Friday gift ideas guide . This guide is written by the SavingArena Editorial Team.
 Frequently Asked Questions
 Quick answers to what readers ask about this topic.
 When do Black Friday electronics deals start in 2026? Target's Early Black Friday ran 5 to 7 November, Best Buy's Early Black Friday deals started on 6 November with new deals every Friday, and Walmart's Early Black Friday event runs 12 to 15 November. Best Buy's 10 days of Black Friday start on 19 November.
 Is Black Friday or Cyber Monday better for electronics? Adobe's 2026 forecast expects the deepest discounts for electronics and computers on Cyber Monday, 30 November, and the best TV deals on Black Friday, 27 November. These are averages, so compare the exact model on both days.
 Which stores have Black Friday tech deals this year? Best Buy, Walmart, Target, Costco and Kohl's had published 2026 Black Friday dates that include electronics when we checked on 1 November. Amazon says its Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deal events kick off at 12:01 a.m. PST on 19 November and run through 30 November, and its deals preview of 9 November names savings on select TVs, headphones, speakers, laptops and gaming PCs.
 Can I return electronics bought on Black Friday? Usually, within the store's window. Best Buy accepts most purchases made from 30 October to 31 December until 15 January 2027, Walmart gives 30 days for most electronics and 14 for phones, and Costco gives 90 days for TVs and computers.
 Should I buy early Black Friday electronics deals or wait? If a fair price appears early, buying can make sense where the store protects you: Best Buy's Holiday Price Match Guarantee matches its own lower price later in the season. Check the store's terms before you rely on it.

Best Early Black Friday Deals on Tech - Consumer Reports

 Best Early Black Friday Deals on Tech
 CR's shopping experts help you find great bargains on TVs, laptops, headphones, and more, all month long

 Holiday savings include deals on electronic devices from Amazon, Apple, and Samsung.
 Photos: Scott Meadows/Consumer Reports, Prop Styling: Megan Hedgpeth
 Looking for a Black Friday deal on headphones? A TV? A laptop? Well, who says you have to wait? We’re already starting to spot deals on tech products recommended by our testers. And CR’s experts are combing through all of the options to bring you the best offers on products that will wow. 
 Because, face it, the best deals involve more than a good price. You want an item that delivers on performance, too. So we look for bargains that measure up to CR’s rigorous lab review process. 
 By shopping now, you can take advantage of early deals and spread out your spending, so you’re not scrambling to buy everything over the Black Friday and Cyber Monday weekend. Better yet, many of the tech items below are priced comparably to what we saw during the big sales events earlier in the year. 
 For everything else on your list, our  Deals hub  has the latest discounts on everything from coffee makers and air fryers to sheets and more. Consumer Reports will be keeping a close eye on all those items throughout the holiday season to help you find what you want for less.

 Smartwatches & Fitness Trackers

 Headphones
 Apple AirPods Pro 3
 The AirPods Pro 3 are Apple’s top-of-the-line earbuds, and they’re jam-packed with features. The newest functions include live translation for overseas travel and a workout mode that allows you to leave your Apple Watch at home while you’re out on a run or ride. The buds still offer a clinical-grade hearing test and the option of turning your Pro 3s into an over-the-counter hearing aid. They also sound good and offer a better fit and noise canceling than last year’s Pro 2s. The Pro 3s don’t go on sale very often, so this is an opportunity to get Apple’s latest tech at an enticing price.
 Still undecided?
 CR's expert guidance and unbiased reviews can help you purchase with confidence.
 Become a Member 
 Sign In 
 Apple AirPods Max 2
 The AirPods Max 2 sound great and have superb and flexible noise-canceling tech. They feature a high-performing transparency mode to pipe in outside sound, as well as spatial audio capability. But the biggest selling point might be the distinctive design and premium feel we’ve come to expect from an Apple product.
 Soundcore Space A40
 If you want a pair of noise-canceling earbuds at a budget price, check out the Soundcore Space A40s . The bass packs some wallop, and the overall sound is warm, which makes the A40s pleasant to listen to over a long period of time. The noise cancellation is impressive, too—there’s even a transparency mode that allows you to monitor your surroundings when you’re out running or walking down a busy street. The discount is not huge, but these headphones are a serious value even at their normal street price.
 Laptops & Computeres
 Apple Mac mini (M6)
 If you’re curious about switching to a Mac, or perhaps just tired of Windows, the 2026 Mac Mini is one of the most affordable entry points into the Apple ecosystem, provided you already have a monitor, mouse, and keyboard handy. Plus, it aces our performance tests.
 Apple MacBook Air - 2026
 The Apple MacBook Air has long been a popular choice for travelers and folks on the go, and the new 13-inch model continues the tradition. It weighs 2.7 pounds, slips easily into a backpack or carry-on, and delivers admirable battery life. Powered by Apple’s M5 processor, it sails through our everyday performance tests and earns praise for the color and sharpness of the display. If you’d like a bit more screen space, the 15-inch MacBook Air is also on sale.
 Smartwatches & Fitness Trackers
 Apple Watch Ultra 4
 The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is Apple’s largest and most capable smartwatch. It offers the full suite of health and fitness features, plus a number of extras built for adventuring. It also has the longest-lasting battery and a bright 49mm display. This sale is limited to certain band colors and sizes.
 TVs
 Hisense 75S7SG
 We didn’t test this 85-inch Hisense TV, part of its CanvasTV line of lifestyle TVs that let you display artwork and photos when you’re not watching shows and movies. But we did test the 75-inch version, the Hisense 75S7SG , and that set does well for overall picture quality, though its HDR performance is only decent. The TV has a matte finish and a 144Hz refresh rate. It uses the Google TV smart system.
 Roku 65R6C7
 The Roku 65R6C7 , a model in the company’s midtier Plus series, does well overall in our tests, though not for HDR, which is relatively ineffective due to the TV’s peak brightness limitations. (This set supports both Dolby Vision and HDR10+ HDR formats, as well as Dolby Atmos audio.) It’s a QLED TV with a Mini LED backlight, and it has a remote-finder button on the TV that, when pressed, will cause the remote to emit a sound. Although not a lifestyle TV per se, it has a Backdrops setting that allows you to display artwork and photos when you’re not watching TV.
 Speakers
 JBL Flip 7
 The compact JBL Flip 7 delivers a lot of speaker for the money. Its classic cylindrical design takes up relatively little space in a beach bag or on a picnic table. The company claims a battery life of up to 16 hours, and the advertised IPX68 water-and-dust-resistance rating means the JBL Flip 7 can survive being fully submerged, which makes it perfect for the beach or any outdoor setting where a shower—or a full-fledged dunking—is a distinct possibility. With slightly boomy bass and subdued trebles, it’s not a device for audiophiles, but it’s got a pleasing sound quality that encourages you to play your tunes one after another. At around $100 for some colors—that’s $50 off—it’s a winner among portables you can toss like a football. 
 Dash Cams
 Viofo A229 Pro
 The Viofo A229 Pro is a superb multicamera dash cam, offering views out both the front and back of your car. It has a 2.4-inch display for reviewing footage, voice control, a GPS antenna for speed and location data, and a removable polarizing lens filter. The dash cam features a vibration- and motion-based parking mode, but it requires a Viofo HK4 hardwire kit ($26, not included), for continuous power when the car is turned off. It uses an adhesive mount with an electrostatic sticker (to prevent adhesive residue from getting on your windshield), supports up to 512-gigabyte microSD cards for video storage, and has apps for Android and iOS. This dash cam is currently almost 40 percent off its list price, and hasn’t been priced this low since April.
 Security Cameras
 Eufy Floodlight Camera E30
 The hardwired Eufy Floodlight Camera E30 has dual 2,000-lumen floodlights that automatically illuminate when movement is detected, plus a 105-decibel siren to deter intruders and a two-way intercom to speak with visitors. This 2K camera scores well in our tests, too. It’s equipped with AI-powered object detection for people and vehicles, customizable activity zones, and motorized pan and tilt to keep them in view. It’s also compatible with Amazon Alexa and Google Home, so you can control the camera with your voice or alongside other devices from those smart home apps. You can use a microSD card to store clips locally, or rely on paid cloud storage. It’s been on sale at this price sporadically throughout the year, but it’s the best deal we’ve seen on a floodlight camera that doesn’t require a subscription.
 Smart Thermostats
 Google Nest Learning Thermostat 4th Gen
 Google’s newest smart thermostat, the  Nest Learning Thermostat 4th gen , comes with a remote temperature sensor that you can place in another room to balance heating and cooling. It’s one of just a few Matter-compatible smart thermostats on the market, meaning it works with any major smart home system, including Apple Home.
 Printers
 Canon imageCLASS MF462dw II
 This black-and-white laser printer is a workhorse at producing crisp, quality text at a clip. As with most laser printers, it doesn’t excel at graphics or photos, but it’s a great pick if you print a lot of text documents. It also scans, copies, and faxes. The estimated toner costs are also far lower than what you find with an inkjet cartridge printer. 
 Routers
 TP-Link Deco XE75 (2-pack)
 Mesh systems are the best way to banish WiFi dead zones forever, and the Deco XE75 Pro is a fine example of just such a system. This 2-pack system uses the newer WiFi 6E standard, which opens up a “fast lane” for compatible devices, reducing interference from your neighbors’ networks. With coverage up to 5,500 square feet, it can blanket a large home in a reliable signal. Getting a high-performance 6E mesh system for under $160 is a rare find, making this one of the standout networking deals of the week.

Black Friday tech deals are the electronics discounts that retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and Target run around Black Friday, the shopping day after US Thanksgiving. In 2026, Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, so Black Friday is Friday, November 27, and Cyber Monday is Monday, November 30. For the full calendar, store hours and every other category, start with our Black Friday 2026 guide.

However, a big red “sale” badge does not make a deal good. This guide therefore starts with where official tech deals are live right now, then covers what a genuinely good price looks like for TVs, laptops, Apple gear, headphones, tablets and smart home devices, which deals to skip, and how to track prices so you buy at the right moment. We quote deal prices only where the retailer itself published them, and list prices only where we checked them on the maker’s own site. Otherwise, use the “check today’s price” links and compare against the numbers below.

Where Are Black Friday Tech Deals Live Right Now?

As of November 10, 2026, official Black Friday tech deals are live at Best Buy and Costco, Walmart’s first event starts November 12, and Amazon, Best Buy and the Microsoft Store all start their main Black Friday events on November 19. Which Black Friday tech deals start on November 19?

Three big Black Friday tech deals events start on Thursday, November 19. First, Amazon’s Black Friday Week opens at 12:01 a.m. PT and runs through Cyber Monday, November 30, according to Amazon’s November 9 first look; Amazon adds that its Today’s Big Deals will drop twice, at midnight and 8 a.m. PT, on Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Second, Best Buy’s 10-day Black Friday Doorbusters and Deals event begins the same day. Third, the Microsoft Store says its Black Friday sale runs November 19–28, although Microsoft had not revealed specific deals when we last checked.

Amazon’s preview also names its own devices: up to 35% off new models such as the Echo Show 16, Fire TV Stick 4K and Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K, and up to 45% off the Amazon Ember 55-inch Fire TV models and the Kindle Colorsoft (2024). However, Amazon has not announced Prime early access for Black Friday Week, so plan on the November 19 start like everyone else.

Pro tip. Amazon’s preview lists “up to” savings, not final prices. So before November 19, note the current price of the exact TV or laptop you want; then you can tell instantly whether the Black Friday price is a real cut.

When Do Black Friday Tech Deals Start in 2026?

Black Friday tech deals usually start weeks before the day itself, and the deepest prices arrive during Cyber Week, the five days from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday (November 26–30, 2026). In fact, Adobe expects discounts of up to 14% in early November and up to 21% just before Thanksgiving, before the Cyber Week peak.

Amazon’s October Prime Day event already ran on October 6–7, 2026, with discounts that Adobe forecast to peak at 19% off list price. As a result, anything you missed then will probably reappear, often cheaper, in late November. This year, Amazon’s Black Friday Week starts November 19, one day earlier than Amazon’s 2025 Black Friday Week, which started November 20 and ran through Cyber Monday, December 1. Our Black Friday sale dates by store page tracks each retailer as announcements land.

Shoppers are also starting early. According to the National Retail Federation’s October 20 holiday survey, 43% of consumers planned to begin holiday shopping before November, yet 64% said they were likely to wait until Thanksgiving weekend for most of it. In addition, the NRF, the largest US retail trade group, forecast on October 15 that November–December retail sales will grow 4.2% to $1.013 trillion.

Are early Black Friday tech deals worth it?

Early Black Friday tech deals are worth it only when the price already matches the product’s historic low. Otherwise, Adobe’s forecast suggests waiting, since early-November discounts (up to 14%) are less than half the Cyber Week peak. That said, popular TV sizes and doorbuster laptops can sell out, so set price alerts now rather than refreshing pages on the day.

What Does a Good Black Friday Tech Deal Look Like?

A good Black Friday tech deal is a price at or below the product’s lowest recorded price, on a current model, from a retailer with a fair return policy. Percentages alone mislead, because the “original” price on the tag is the retailer’s choice.

Federal rules back this up. Specifically, the FTC’s Guides Against Deceptive Pricing say a former-price comparison is only legitimate when the item was really offered at that price for a reasonably substantial period. In practice, enforcement is uneven, so check the history yourself. Then use these benchmarks:

Electronics overall: about 30% off list is the forecast peak, so 30% or more on a current model is a strong deal.
TVs: about 23% off is the forecast peak, so judge older models against their own price history rather than the tag.
Laptops and computers: about 23% off is a solid benchmark.
Apple: any discount below the pre-June 2026 list price is notable (see the Apple section).

Pro tip. Before you buy, paste the exact model number into a search engine. If the only results are Black Friday ads, you are probably looking at a derivative model with no price history to compare.

Black Friday TV Deals: What to Expect

Black Friday TV deals are usually the strongest of the season on Black Friday itself; Adobe expects TV discounts to peak at about 23% off list price (versus 24.2% in 2025), with the best TV prices landing on November 27. So if a TV is your big purchase, Black Friday, not Cyber Monday, is the day to buy.

Costco has already posted the first official Black Friday TV prices of 2026. Its Black Friday page, checked November 10, lists the TCL 65-inch QM6K Pro at $499.99, TCL Q77L sets from $259.99 to $379.99 and the Hisense 100-inch QD7 at $999.99, valid November 27–30, while the Sony BRAVIA 6 OLED (55- and 65-inch) is already $999.99 to $1,199.99 online through November 30. However, Costco notes that valid dates vary by item, so recheck before you shop. Amazon, meanwhile, promises up to $600 off select Sony and Hisense TVs during its November 19–30 Black Friday Week, according to its November 9 announcement, but it has not published model-by-model prices yet.

What is the best time to buy a TV on Black Friday?

The best time to buy a TV is on Black Friday or in the days just before it, based on Adobe’s forecast. Still, it pays to keep watching afterward. Back in 2015, a Consumer Reports analysis cited by NBC News found about 40% of TVs were cheaper after Black Friday, so retailer price-adjustment windows matter.

Black Friday 4K TV deals: 65-inch sets

A 65-inch 4K TV is a popular size for living rooms, so it is worth planning the purchase carefully. First, decide between panel types: OLED offers perfect blacks, while Mini-LED and QLED sets get brighter for sunny rooms. Next, check the HDMI 2.1 port count if you game, then compare that exact model across retailers.

Are Black Friday TV deals worth it?

Yes, Black Friday TV deals are often worth it for established models, because TVs are one of the categories Adobe expects to be cheapest on that day. However, cheaper “derivative” models can look like bargains while quietly cutting features, which is the next section.

Which Black Friday Tech Deals Should You Skip?

Skip “derivative” TVs and laptops, unknown brands with no reviews, last-gen gear priced above the current model, and deals that are only cheap because of a fake “was” price. Each one looks like a bargain but often isn’t.

Derivative TVs are limited-run models with a slightly different model number, sometimes with fewer HDMI ports, cheaper parts or a slower panel. Because they are new, there are no reviews and no price history, and retailer price matching usually covers only identical models. Consumer Reports has called the practice a strategy that makes direct price comparisons harder, according to the NBC News report linked above. That said, some derivatives perform close to the regular model, so research the exact model before ruling it out.

Watch out. A doorbuster TV sold by only one retailer, in only one size, with zero reviews is a classic derivative red flag. Compare its spec sheet line by line with the regular model from the same brand.

Skip: laptops with 8GB of RAM and slow eMMC storage sold as “holiday specials”, unless the use is very light.
Skip: older Apple models discounted to roughly the price of the current model.
Skip: bundles padded with accessories you would never buy separately.
Skip: marketplace listings from unknown third-party sellers, which may not get the retailer’s holiday return window.

Black Friday Laptop Deals: Windows, Chromebooks and Macs

Black Friday laptop deals are usually deepest on Cyber Monday, according to Adobe, which expects computer discounts to peak at about 23% off list price (versus 22.8% in 2025). So, unless a specific doorbuster appears on Black Friday, it often pays to wait until November 30 for laptops.

Meanwhile, focus on specifications rather than brand names. In 2026, a sensible everyday Windows laptop has at least 16GB of RAM, a 512GB SSD and a display bright enough for daytime use. Chromebooks, by contrast, can get away with less memory because ChromeOS is lighter.

Early official laptop deals are also appearing. For example, Costco lists $400 off the HP OmniBook X 14 and $350 off the HP OmniBook 3 17.3 (online) for November 19–30, then $500 off the HP OmniBook 5 16 (online), $300 off the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 5i 16 and $250 off the ASUS ZenBook DUO (online) for November 27–30, all Copilot+ PCs. Amazon, for its part, says select laptops and gaming PCs from ASUS, Acer, Alienware, Lenovo and HP will be up to 30% off during Black Friday Week. The best Black Friday laptop deals for students are often on Apple’s entry Macs and mid-range Windows laptops, but compare them first with education pricing, which is available all year. Apple has, however, started its holiday return window: Apple Store purchases received from November 6 through December 25, 2026 can be returned until January 8, 2027.

Black Friday iPhone deals: how carrier offers work

Black Friday iPhone deals are mostly carrier offers, and they usually pay out as monthly bill credits over up to 36 months rather than as an instant discount. In other words, the “free” iPhone is free only if you keep the line, on an eligible plan, for the full term.

Credits stop if you cancel, pay off the phone early or switch to an ineligible plan, as Gizmodo’s carrier deal breakdown explains. For the current lineup and prices, see our iPhone 18 guide.
Plan requirements often mean a pricier unlimited tier, so add up the extra monthly cost over the full term.
Trade-ins are typically paid as bill credits too, and values depend on the model you hand in.
Unlocked deals from retailers are rarer on the newest iPhone, but older models sometimes see straight discounts.

How to Track Prices Before Black Friday

The easiest way to track prices before Black Friday is to set price-drop alerts now on Google and on an Amazon price-history tool, so you know the real low before the sales start. Here is a simple five-step routine:

1. Shortlist exact model numbers for each item you want, not just product names.
2. Set Google price alerts. Google’s Track price feature lets signed-in users track a product and optionally set a target price, with alerts by push notification and email.
3. Check Amazon price history with tools such as Keepa or CamelCamelCamel, which chart past Amazon prices and send drop alerts.
4. Compare retailers on the same model number, including Best Buy, Walmart and Target, and add shipping costs.
5. Know the return and price-adjustment rules. Retailers often extend holiday return windows. Best Buy says most purchases made October 30 through December 31, 2026 can be returned through January 15, 2027 (January 31 for My Best Buy Plus and Total members), and its Holiday Price Match Guarantee excludes Marketplace items. Target’s holiday FAQ gives purchases made November 1 to December 24, 2026 extra time: most electronics must be back by January 24, 2027, and Apple, Beats and mobile phones by January 8, 2027. The Microsoft Store accepts eligible physical products bought October 1 to December 2, 2026 through January 31, 2027. Apple Store purchases received November 6 to December 25, 2026 can be returned through January 8, 2027, according to Apple’s returns policy as reported by MacRumors. Walmart had not posted its 2026 holiday return terms on its own site as of November 10, 2026, so confirm the official terms before relying on them.

Pro tip. If a price drops after you buy, ask the retailer about a price adjustment within its policy window before returning the item. It is faster than a return and rebuy, and you keep the product.

Electronics and computers, meanwhile, are forecast to bottom out on Cyber Monday, so read our Cyber Monday 2026 guide before deciding which day to buy.

Our verdict

The best Black Friday tech deals in 2026 reward preparation, not speed. Best Buy and Costco deals are already live, Walmart follows on November 12, and Amazon, Best Buy and the Microsoft Store start their main events on November 19. Buy TVs on Black Friday, wait until Cyber Monday for laptops, headphones and most other electronics, and treat any discount of 30% or more on a current, well-reviewed model as a strong deal.
